text.title: Dark store in Kazan, project 2026
text.motivation: Kazan orders grew 40% in a year; the nearest store is 25 minutes away
text.participants: ops team, courier partner, city council, landlord
text.goals: 80% of Kazan orders delivered within 1 hour; 3 000 orders a week by Q4
text.benefits: groceries within 1 hour, fresh produce, lower delivery fee
text.activities: lease site, fit out cold rooms, hire 20 pickers, set up routes
text.deliverables: working dark store, pickers' schedule, KPI dashboard
text.risks: rent may rise 15%; winter courier shortage; 6-month lease option
text.milestones: lease signed 1 Nov; fit-out 1 Dec – 15 Jan; launch 1 Feb 2027
text.constraints: fire code limits night work; budget capped at 45 M
text.scope: in: 5 districts, groceries only. Out: alcohol, pharmacy
text.project_end: two months at the KPI, or a stop decision after the pilot
